settings.historyLimitHint: Number of operations that can be undone ({min}–{max})
settings.penDisablesFingerHint: After the pen is first used, a finger only moves and zooms the view (until the end of the session)
settings.autosaveHint: Backup copy of the lesson every so many minutes ({min}–{max}) in the recovery folder. The lesson file changes only on “Save”.

file.discardConfirm: The lesson “{file}” has unsaved changes. Discard these changes?
file.restoreConfirm: The previous session was not closed properly. Restore the autosave of the lesson “{file}” ({when})?

history.redoHint: Redo (Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z, tap with three fingers)

layers.title: Layers
layers.drag: Drag to change the position of the layer “{name}”

notice.pluginInvalid: The layer “{name}” cannot be loaded: the plugin package is invalid.
notice.pluginIncompatible: The layer “{name}” requires plugin API version {required}, but the program provides version {provided}. The layer was not loaded.
notice.pluginDuplicate: The layer “{name}” is already loaded. The second copy of the plugin was skipped.
notice.pluginFailed: The layer “{name}” stopped working because of an error in its plugin. Other layers keep working, and the data of this layer will be kept when saving.
notice.layerBroken: The layer “{name}” was marked as broken after an error in its plugin. Other layers keep working, and the data of this layer will be kept when saving.
notice.shortcutConflict: The shortcut {keys} of the layer “{name}” is already taken and was not assigned.
notice.historyLocked: The next undo or redo step changes the layer “{name}”, which is locked. Unlock it in the layer panel to undo or redo.
notice.historyHidden: The next undo or redo step changes the layer “{name}”, which is hidden. Show it in the layer panel to undo or redo.
notice.layerNewer: The layer “{name}” was saved by a newer version of its plugin. Its data will be kept unchanged, but it cannot be edited.
notice.fileCorrupt: The file “{file}” cannot be opened: it is damaged or it is not a Tablica lesson.
notice.fileNewer: The file “{file}” was saved by a newer version of the program. Update Tablica to open it.
notice.fileReadFailed: The file “{file}” cannot be read. Check that the file still exists.
notice.fileWriteFailed: The file “{file}” could not be saved. The previous version of the file was left unchanged.
notice.autosaveFailed: The autosave of the lesson “{file}” failed.
notice.recoveryFailed: The autosave of the lesson “{file}” cannot be restored: the copy is damaged.
